PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Ernest's clue ("He was in the Security Office, but not beside a locker. He was in a corner of his area."). So Ernest (E) must be at row 1, column 9. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Look at Cora: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 7, column 5. So nobody else can stand at row 7, column 5, or Cora would have nowhere to go. Look at Gilbert: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 2, column 4. So nobody else can stand at row 2, column 4, or Gilbert would have nowhere to go. Look at Gilbert: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 5, column 8. So nobody else can stand at row 5, column 8, or Gilbert would have nowhere to go. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Felix is now the only person who can still go in row 4. So Felix (F) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Suppose Helena were at row 3, column 8: then nobody could stand in column 7. So Helena can't be there. Only one square of column 8 is still open to anyone (row 2, column 8). Someone must stand there, so nobody else can use row 2. Cora is now the only person who can still go in column 6. So Cora (C) must be at row 7, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Bert that fits his clue ("He was exactly two rows north of Dinah."). So Bert (B) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Using Bert's clue ("He was exactly two rows north of Dinah."), some squares are ruled out for Dinah. So Dinah (D) must be at row 8, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Agnes that fits her clue ("She was in the Workshop or the Painting Gallery."). So Agnes (A) must be at row 9, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Suppose Gilbert were at row 5, column 4: then the victim's clue (alone with the murderer) could not be true. So Gilbert can't be there. So Gilbert (G) must be at row 2, column 8. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Virgil. So Virgil (the victim) must be at row 5, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Helena that fits her clue ("She was exactly two rows south of Ernest."). So Helena (H) must be at row 3, column 4. Cross out her row and column. Dinah is the only person in the Cafe with Virgil, so Dinah is the murderer!
